content:
The image shows a severely desiccated, brown, shriveled leaf. The entire leaf has turned brown/tan with a dry, papery texture and irregular, necrotic margins. There is no white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew), no black sooty layer (rules out Sooty_Mould), and no distinct dark lesions with defined borders typical of Anthracnose.

This pattern — a shoot or leaf that has withered, browned, and died back from the tip — is characteristic of **Die_Back**, where tissue progressively dies from the extremities inward, resulting in complete necrosis and a dried-out appearance.
